name: ANLON HEALTHCARE LIMITED
summary: Anlon Healthcare Limited manufactures and sells advance pharmaceutical intermediates in India and internationally. The company offers active pharmaceutical ingredients (API); nutraceutical API products; personal care ingredients; and veterinary API products. Its products are used in anti-inflammatory (NSAID), analgesic, antipyretic, antihistamine, antidepressant, antipsychotic, anticoagulant, antihypertensive, nutrition, anti-arrhythmic, anti-hyper parathyroid, antiplatelet, ant diabetic, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and anti-rheumatic therapeutics areas. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Rajkot, India.
